name: @stump/ui
description: Shared Svelte UI foundation for the Stump companion apps (editor/, home/): GraphQL client, shared GraphQL operations, shadcn-svelte components and small utilities. Source-only: each app links `src/` into its tree (`src/lib/stump-ui`) and aliases `@stump/ui` to it, so the package is typechecked, bundled and installed through the consuming app. Runtime dependencies are declared as peers and installed by each app.
